name: twenty
blocker: Server hard-requires Redis (REDIS_URL for cache storage, session storage and the BullMQ worker: cache-storage.module-factory.ts:27, session-storage.module-factory.ts:42, redis-client.service.ts:24); CI starts a redis service plus a separate worker process.
migrate: npx nx run twenty-server:database:reset (CI; not run)
appStart: npx nx run twenty-server:start:ci + npx nx run twenty-server:worker (CI; not run)
notes: CI runs on an 8-core runner with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=10240 and serves the front build from the server (cp -r packages/twenty-front/build packages/twenty-server/dist/front); heavy even without the Redis blocker.
